defmodule MonitorAgent.Auth do
  @moduledoc """
  Cross-service authentication module for the monitoring agent.
  Uses HMAC-SHA256 tokens with service-specific secrets.
  """

  @token_ttl_seconds 300
  @secret_key_base Application.compile_env(:monitor_agent, :secret_key_base, "default_dev_key_do_not_use")

  defstruct [:service_id, :timestamp, :nonce, :signature]

  @doc "Generates an authentication token for outbound requests"
  def generate_token(service_id) do
    timestamp = System.system_time(:second)
    nonce = :crypto.strong_rand_bytes(16) |> Base.encode16(case: :lower)
    payload = build_payload(service_id, timestamp, nonce)
    signature = compute_hmac(payload)

    %__MODULE__{
      service_id: service_id,
      timestamp: timestamp,
      nonce: nonce,
      signature: signature
    }
  end

  @doc "Validates an inbound authentication token from a peer service"
  def validate_token(%{"service_id" => service_id, "timestamp" => ts_str,
                      "nonce" => nonce, "signature" => signature}) do
    with {:ok, timestamp} <- parse_timestamp(ts_str),
         :ok <- check_freshness(timestamp),
         :ok <- check_nonce_reuse(service_id, nonce),
         :ok <- verify_signature(service_id, timestamp, nonce, signature) do
      record_nonce(service_id, nonce)
      {:ok, service_id}
    end
  end

  def validate_token(_), do: {:error, :malformed_token}

  defp parse_timestamp(ts_str) when is_binary(ts_str) do
    case Integer.parse(ts_str) do
      {ts, ""} -> {:ok, ts}
      _ -> {:error, :invalid_timestamp}
    end
  end
  defp parse_timestamp(ts) when is_integer(ts), do: {:ok, ts}
  defp parse_timestamp(_), do: {:error, :invalid_timestamp}

  defp check_freshness(timestamp) do
    now = System.system_time(:second)
    if abs(now - timestamp) <= @token_ttl_seconds do
      :ok
    else
      {:error, :token_expired}
    end
  end

  defp check_nonce_reuse(service_id, nonce) do
    key = {service_id, nonce}
    case :ets.lookup(:auth_nonces, key) do
      [] -> :ok
      _ -> {:error, :nonce_reused}
    end
  end

  defp record_nonce(service_id, nonce) do
    key = {service_id, nonce}
    :ets.insert(:auth_nonces, {key, System.system_time(:second)})
  end

  defp verify_signature(service_id, timestamp, nonce, provided_signature) do
    payload = build_payload(service_id, timestamp, nonce)
    expected = compute_hmac(payload)
    if secure_compare(expected, provided_signature) do
      :ok
    else
      {:error, :invalid_signature}
    end
  end

  defp build_payload(service_id, timestamp, nonce) do
    "#{service_id}|#{timestamp}|#{nonce}"
  end

  defp compute_hmac(payload) do
    :crypto.mac(:hmac, :sha256, derive_key(), payload)
    |> Base.encode16(case: :lower)
  end

  defp derive_key do
    :crypto.hash(:sha256, @secret_key_base)
  end

  # Constant-time comparison to prevent timing attacks
  defp secure_compare(left, right) when byte_size(left) != byte_size(right) do
    # Still do work to avoid leaking length info via timing
    dummy = :binary.copy(<<0>>, byte_size(left))
    _result = :crypto.hash_equals(dummy, dummy)
    false
  end
  defp secure_compare(left, right) do
    :crypto.hash_equals(left, right)
  end

end

defmodule MonitorAgent.Collector do
  @moduledoc """
  Collects metrics from peer services after authenticating.
  """
  use GenServer
  require Logger

  @poll_interval_ms 5_000

  def start_link(opts) do
    GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, opts, name: __MODULE__)
  end

  def init(opts) do
    :ets.new(:auth_nonces, [:named_table, :set, :public])
    schedule_poll()
    {:ok, %{peers: Keyword.get(opts, :peers, []), metrics: %{}}}
  end

  def handle_info(:poll, state) do
    new_metrics = Enum.reduce(state.peers, state.metrics, fn peer, acc ->
      case fetch_metrics(peer) do
        {:ok, data} -> Map.put(acc, peer, data)
        {:error, reason} ->
          Logger.warning("Failed to collect from #{peer}: #{inspect(reason)}")
          acc
      end
    end)
    schedule_poll()
    {:noreply, %{state | metrics: new_metrics}}
  end

  def handle_call({:authenticate, token_params}, _from, state) do
    result = MonitorAgent.Auth.validate_token(token_params)
    {:reply, result, state}
  end

  def handle_call(:get_metrics, _from, state) do
    {:reply, {:ok, state.metrics}, state}
  end

  defp fetch_metrics(peer) do
    token = MonitorAgent.Auth.generate_token("monitor_agent")
    headers = [
      {"X-Service-Id", token.service_id},
      {"X-Auth-Timestamp", Integer.to_string(token.timestamp)},
      {"X-Auth-Nonce", token.nonce},
      {"X-Auth-Signature", token.signature}
    ]

    # Enforce TLS certificate verification to prevent MITM when peers use HTTPS.
    ssl_opts = [
      verify: :verify_peer,
      cacerts: :public_key.cacerts_get(),
      depth: 3,
      customize_hostname_check: [
        match_fun: :public_key.pkix_verify_hostname_match_fun(:https)
      ],
      versions: [:"tlsv1.2", :"tlsv1.3"]
    ]

    http_opts = [{:timeout, 3000}, {:ssl, ssl_opts}]

    case :httpc.request(:get, {~c"#{peer}/metrics", headers}, http_opts, []) do
      {:ok, {{_, 200, _}, _, body}} -> {:ok, body}
      {:ok, {{_, code, _}, _, _}} -> {:error, {:http_error, code}}
      {:error, reason} -> {:error, reason}
    end
  end

  defp schedule_poll do
    Process.send_after(self(), :poll, @poll_interval_ms)
  end
end
